title: NRO neutrino detectors used to target and down ET craft

tellings.quote: They didn't know the NRO had nutrino light detectors on them picking up the signature of the ET craft and knocking them down.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who has long campaigned for the government to reveal what it knows about aliens, says on a podcast that the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites, had detectors for neutrinos, tiny particles that pass through almost anything, on its satellites. According to Greer, those detectors picked up the signature of alien craft so they could be targeted and knocked out of the sky, without other people knowing. If true, it would mean the US secretly hunts and downs visiting craft.
